source: nflverse-data (stats_player_week, schedules); halftime scores from ESPN's scoreboard
method: Gaussian-copula r that reproduces how often both legs hit at each group's median lines (anytime TD 1+, passing TDs 2+, game lines at the closing number); role = position and that season's targets or carries a game; check = the same at upper-third lines. win and h1win are fitted within 3-point bands of the closing spread; rows with a side (dog: underdog of 3.5+, fav: favourite of 3.5+, even: between) are the spread and moneyline lines fitted on those games alone, the same way; the first-half total and spread are cut at straight-line fits on the closing total and spread

lines.over: game total Over the closing total
lines.cover: his team covers the closing spread
lines.tt: his team Over its implied total, (total -/+ spread) / 2
lines.h1over: first-half points Over the first-half total
lines.h1cover: his team covers the first-half spread
lines.h1win: his team leads at the half (ties left out)
